title: NativeOntologyAssetCluster
description: A native concept with the catalog assets bound to it that the caller may view.

serviceType.description: Service type of the asset, for asset types that record one.

columnCount.description: Number of column paths bound on this asset.

assetCount.description: Number of bound assets the caller may view.

assets.description: First page of viewable assets, ordered by asset id.

after.description: Cursor the concept's bindings endpoint accepts for the next page of viewable assets. Absent when this page holds every viewable asset.
